# OpenAI Staffer Charged With Planting Bug Released on Bond

![The Phillip Burton Federal Building and US Courthouse during a detention hearing for Abdulrahman Alfozan in San Francisco on Oct. 19.](https://assets.bwbx.io/images/users/iqjWHBFdfxIU/i8uoqE1PHEJs/v1/-1x-1.webp)

The Phillip Burton Federal Building and US Courthouse during a detention hearing for Abdulrahman Alfozan in San Francisco on Oct. 19. Photographer: David Paul Morris/Bloomberg

By Madlin Mekelburg and Peter Blumberg

November 24, 2026 at 8:17 PM UTC

A federal magistrate judge ordered that the OpenAI staffer charged with bugging a company office conference room be released on a $1 million bond, finding that prosecutors have not presented enough evidence of wrongdoing to keep him in custody.

Once he is released, Abdulrahman Alfozan cannot travel outside Northern California or seek new travel documents, US Magistrate Judge Alex Tse said from the bench on Tuesday.
